title: Inspector smoke payload — minimal valid input for the lean ★ elementor.design.classes.list tool
_comment: WP-Q03 — Inspector smoke (14-fixtures-harness.md §8; 13-tool-catalog.md §5.2 #13, §1.4). design.classes.list is READ-ONLY (readOnlyHint/idempotentHint; proxied-to-REST GET elementor-ultra/v1/design/classes; paginated §0.6). GET reads remain available even without the UPDATE_CLASS cap (S05/C4 — only the PUT/write is cap-gated), but global classes are a v4 feature, so requires.experiments gates this on e_classes (a classes-disabled site SKIPS). MINIMAL valid input per §1.4: every field is optional/defaulted ({context?='frontend'} + §0.6 {limit?,cursor?,fields?}); we set a small `limit`. The §8 suite asserts no protocol error (-326xx) and a result matching the paginated outputSchema {items[GlobalClassObject], next_cursor, total, order[]}.
